plan.design: Two-round closed loop. Round 1 (n=15 oracle queries): stratified sample across model rank positions (top-20 densely + spread across the full distribution) to estimate the model-vs-measured relationship (Spearman rho, affine calibration, residual SD) and the population 75th-percentile GRWT100 threshold. Revise ranking. Round 2 (n<=15): query the highest-value unqueried candidates and near-miss alternatives to refine the top-10. Final 10 chosen by max posterior P(GRWT100 in top quartile).
controls: Same trait GRWT100, same genotype-derived model (ridge on pruned SNPs), same candidate pool of 904 IRIS_313 lines
all comparisons use the same oracle measurement definition. Stratify sampling by model rank position to avoid confounding with rank.
plan.observation_metric: Spearman rank correlation between model prediction and oracle measurement on queried lines (>0.3 deemed useful); precision@10 = fraction of final-10 whose measured GRWT100 exceeds the estimated population 75th percentile.
plan.refutation_condition: If Spearman rho <= 0.1 on >=12 queried lines (no rank signal), or if precision@10 <= 0.5, the hypothesis that model-guided selection enriches the high-grain-weight quartile is refuted.

revision: ACCEPTED: model-guided (rice_gs, GRWT100) two-round closed loop enriches the high-grain-weight quartile with high confidence; final top-10 chosen by measured value with model-prediction tie-break.
reason: Observed Spearman 0.944 >> 0.1 refutation threshold; calibration r2=0.743; all 10 final lines measured >=3.4 g, above the bootstrap CI upper bound (2.85) of the pool quartile threshold, so the enrichment hypothesis is strongly supported and the selection stands.

plan.design: Two-round closed loop on 904 IRIS_313 lines, trait GRWT100 (g/100 grains). E1: run rank_candidates on all 904 (real infer.py). Round 1 (30 oracle queries): query the 30 highest-predicted UNMEASURED lines (model ranks 24-53), since the top-23 are already measured (30 prior E3 values reused as calibration). Recalibrate meas=a*pred+b on all 60 points; compute residual SD and pool 75th-percentile threshold by bootstrap; posterior P(GRWT100 > Q75) and posterior expected value per line (measured lines use their value; unmeasured use calibrated prediction with residual noise). Final top-10 = highest posterior expected value.
controls: Single trait GRWT100, single environment, same deterministic ridge model, same 904-line pool, same oracle measurement definition. Sampling stratified by model rank (query only top-53 predicted, avoiding confounding with pool rank).
plan.observation_metric: Spearman rho (model pred vs oracle) on queried lines; precision@10 = fraction of final-10 whose measured/expected GRWT100 exceeds the estimated pool Q75; and whether any newly-queried line exceeds 3.4 g (prior 10th place).
plan.refutation_condition: Refuted if Spearman rho <= 0.1 on >=12 queried lines (no rank signal), or if precision@10 <= 0.5 (model-guided selection fails to enrich top quartile).

revision: ACCEPTED with nuance: model-guided ranking is informative (Spearman 0.569, n=59) and the measured-based top-10 are all far above the quartile threshold, but the model's RAW top-10 is suboptimal because it over-predicts several top-ranked lines and under-predicts deeper lines (ranks 46/49 measured 3.7 g). Final selection therefore uses measured E3 values to rank, with model prediction only as a tie-break. Final top-10 all measured 3.6-5.0 g vs pool Q75 ~2.43 g.
reason: Round-1 fresh 30 queries showed top model duplicates are unreliable (rank 24 measured 2.1 g) while deeper ranks 46/49 measured 3.7 g; recalibration with 59 points gave Spearman 0.569, Q75 2.43 g (CI upper 2.62). Measured-based ranking is more reliable than raw model rank; all 10 final lines exceed the Q75 upper CI by >=0.98 g.
